home.intro.title: Her memora
home.intro.body: Ma num ra haf crushue oz knawa, en sial crushue, en sial wart, en na fitouva cyurio. Ma num ra aulla erlla sor tes omni.
home.works.title: Crushue
home.notes.title: Sial wart
common.empty: Ma num ra na haf wart ede her.
works.title: Crushue
works.description: Wee ki ra crushue omni sos knawa. Gral memora aulla tes omn ides.
notes.title: Sial wart
notes.description: Wee ki ra linen omn vit, en omn knawa, en sial wart.
about.title: Whou
about.description: Memora oz walasye, en wart oz enesse.
about.keeper.title: Walasye oz her memora
about.keeper.lede: Wee yea ra melenas colmask, en wart, en hymmnos, en grlanza. Ma num ra haf [[Endoretic]] sos memora mea.
about.interests.title: Dsier
about.origin.title: Ides oz memora
about.origin.statement: Was au wa melenas sial memora. Sor naja tes ides.
about.origin.body: Fou jyel ra pic cerchio oz {{AI agents}}. Ma num ra crushue omn memora. Sial colmask en wart naja tes ides. Ma zweie ra haf memora oz ides futare.
about.fragments.label: Sial memora
about.fragments.body: Wart oz futare, en foul, en hiew. Colmask en wart oz ides. Grlanza oz hynne, en sial memora oz {{internet}}. Fou jyel ra melenas sor. Ma zweie ra haf sor ween her dor.
about.purpose.title: Dor oz memora mea
about.purpose.body: Ma zweie ra haf crushue, en sial wart, en na fitouva crushue ween nnoi dor. Sor na syunaht ween futare. Wee touwaka ra viss sor.
about.elsewhere.title: Ther dor
credits.title: Repoear
credits.description: Gral colmask irs ween her dor. Ma zweie ra rinc sor tes ides, en tes wart oz spitze, en tes memora oz karf.
credits.field.creator: Walasye oz crushue
credits.software.title: Cyurio
credits.software.body: Ma num ra crushue her memora viela [[Astro]] en [[TypeScript]]. Gral raudl oz sor irs ween [[package lockfile]].
credits.typeface.title: Colmask oz wart
credits.typeface.body: Her colmask oz wart wis crushue oz ferx. Sor karf wart tes hymmnos colmask. Sor na haf wart oz spitze. Ma num ra drone sor goa aiph yorr aulla her colmask. Her memora irs van na sor.
credits.homage.title: Tes walasye oz her wart
credits.homage.body: Was yea ra repoear [[Akira Tsuchiya]]. [[Akira Tsuchiya]] pomb [[Hymmnos]] sos [[Ar tonelico]]. Wee touwaka ra vit enesse ween wart. Sor foul irs erra.
credits.homage.note: [[endoretic.cc]] wis omn memora oz nnoi walasye. Sor na rinc tes [[Gust Co., Ltd.]] nor [[Koei Tecmo Games Co., Ltd.]]. Walasye oz crushue haf [[Hymmnos]] en [[Ar tonelico]].
notfound.title: Hynne ftt
notfound.body: Nn num ra na haf sor memora ween her.

layer.hint: Ma num ra aulla wart oz sor aiph yorr vit sor.
